scope: Independent structural, focused-regression, and synthetic-scale audit. No experiment held-out frames were opened.

focused_tests.environment_note: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1; reviewer-local basetemp. The sole warning was inability to write the repository .pytest_cache and did not affect test results.

structural_findings.retained_tracklet_count_mismatch: PASS: based on retained tracklet IDs rather than raw finite-mouth detections; applies to two- and three-view groups.
structural_findings.group_evidence: PASS: robust median plus MAD residual, mouth confidence, missing-view penalty, and bounded saturating support bonus; no duration-summed residual.
structural_findings.optional_unassignment: PASS: every dropped eligible group has a nonzero explicit drop cost; eligible coverage is reported.
structural_findings.brief_all_view_break: PASS: explicit end-to-start link with symmetric forward/backward velocity error, velocity-angle guard, hard 3D gate, and all-view-break penalty.
structural_findings.long_gap: PASS: gaps over the configured maximum create path_segment restarts with continuity_claimed=false.
structural_findings.segment_propagation: PASS: path_segment is propagated to selected_observations and must be retained by every downstream A4/A5 export and accuracy mapping.
structural_findings.velocity_complexity: PASS: deterministic lags 1,2,4,8,16,32,64 replace the prior O(n^2) pairwise estimator; work and temporary slopes are O(n).
structural_findings.beam_memory: PASS structurally: compact last-group state, history backpointers, and future-use resource-owner pruning replace full path tuple copying.

synthetic_scale.data: Generated geometry only; no experiment frames.
synthetic_scale.interpretation: Memory growth was bounded in this repeated-resource case. Runtime remains materially dependent on the real eligible-group count, so full-recording feasibility is not established by this synthetic audit.

remaining_acceptance_conditions: Audit the integrated A4/A5 runner and every downstream use of path_segment.
Record real training and full-recording group counts, wall time, and external process-tree peak RSS.
Verify resume/checkpoint behavior and deterministic scientific output hashes.
Do not open held-out cohorts until the timestamped frozen configuration exists.
